title: Treasure Island Elementary School
address:
7540 E Treasure Dr
North Bay Village, Florida 33141
United States
description:
Treasure Island Elementary School (TIES) in North Bay Village is getting a new Soccer/Community Center Complex spanning both Village- and school-owned property, with illuminated multipurpose fields and a perimeter exercise path.

The project also coordinates the school's after-school programs with AFA athletic training, and includes temporary neighborhood park space to keep recreational access available during construction.

The broader scope covers campus-wide renovations, including new sidewalks, curbs, and gutters to replace cracked and uneven sections, along with new ADA-compliant ramps and walkways throughout the school.
